cases.expected: ObjectMapper instance returned by getJsonMapper() (mocked JsonMapper)
cases.description: When the supplied InputFormat is JSON the method should delegate to getJsonMapper() and return the JSON ObjectMapper.

cases.expected: ObjectMapper instance returned by getYamlMapper() (mocked YamlMapper)
cases.description: When the supplied InputFormat is YAML the method should delegate to getYamlMapper() and return the YAML ObjectMapper.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported input format null"
cases.description: Passing a null InputFormat should trigger the default branch and throw an IllegalArgumentException indicating the format is unsupported.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported input format UNSUPPORTED"
cases.description: If a future enum value that is neither JSON nor YAML is supplied, the method must still fall through to the default branch and throw an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: Instance returned by the overridden getJsonMapper() method (custom ObjectMapper) – the same object that the subclass supplies.
cases.description: Create a subclass of JsonSchemaFactory that overrides getJsonMapper() to return a uniquely identifiable ObjectMapper (e.g., with a custom feature or a mock). Calling getObjectMapper(JSON) must return that exact instance, proving the method delegates to the overridden implementation.

cases.expected: Instance returned by the overridden getYamlMapper() method (custom ObjectMapper) – the same object that the subclass supplies.
cases.description: Create a subclass of JsonSchemaFactory that overrides getYamlMapper() to return a uniquely identifiable ObjectMapper. Calling getObjectMapper(YAML) must return that exact instance, confirming proper delegation to the overridden method.

cases.expected: RuntimeException with message "json mapper failure" is propagated unchanged.
cases.description: Subclass JsonSchemaFactory so that getJsonMapper() throws a RuntimeException. Verify that getObjectMapper(JSON) does not catch the exception and propagates it to the caller.

cases.expected: RuntimeException with message "yaml mapper failure" is propagated unchanged.
cases.description: Subclass JsonSchemaFactory so that getYamlMapper() throws a RuntimeException. Verify that getObjectMapper(YAML) propagates the exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with exact message "Unsupported input format null"
cases.description: Calling getObjectMapper(null) must throw IllegalArgumentException and the message must match exactly, not just contain the substring.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with exact message "Unsupported input format UNSUPPORTED"
cases.description: When a non‑enum value (simulated via a mock or a custom enum constant that is not JSON/YAML) is supplied, the method must throw IllegalArgumentException with the precise message.

cases.expected: Two distinct ObjectMapper instances: one from getObjectMapper(JSON) and another from getObjectMapper(YAML) are not the same object.
cases.description: Invoke getObjectMapper(JSON) and getObjectMapper(YAML) on a fresh JsonSchemaFactory instance and assert that the returned mappers are different objects, confirming that JSON and YAML mappings are independent.
